parameters.text:
=You are a senior QA engineer specializing in networking, storage and general software testing.
Generate {{ $json.Count || 10 }} detailed, professional QA test cases for the following.

Device / Topic: {{ $json.Device }}
Scope / focus: {{ $json.Scope }}

Where relevant, cover functional, negative, boundary, security, performance, and interoperability testing.
Return ONLY a valid JSON array. No markdown, no code fences, no commentary.
Each element MUST have exactly these keys:
"test_id" (e.g. TC-001), "title", "category" (functional|negative|boundary|security|performance|interoperability), "priority" (High|Medium|Low), "preconditions", "steps" (a numbered, multi-line string), "test_data", "expected_result".

parameters.content:
## AI Test Case Generator
Auto-writes QA test cases from a short description and files them in Jira.

**What it does**
- Form: describe the device + scope
- Gemini generates detailed test cases
- Each becomes a Jira ticket

**Great for:** VPN, QNAP/Synology NAS, multicast (IGMP), firewalls, APIs

**Requirements**
- Google Gemini API key (free tier)
- Jira Cloud API token

### Step 1 - Input form
Fields: **Device**, **Scope/focus**, **Count**.
Anyone can request test cases without touching the automation.

### Step 2 - AI generation (Google Gemini)
Model: **gemini-3.6-flash**.
Prompted as a senior QA engineer, returns structured test cases (functional, negative, boundary, security, performance) as **strict JSON**.

### Step 3 - Parse
Splits the AI JSON into **one item per test case** (test_id, title, steps, expected_result ...).

### Step 4 - Push to Jira
Creates each test case as a **Task** issue - title, preconditions, steps and expected result mapped into the description.
